title: RASMI: Regional Assessment of buildings' Material Intensities, the ranges of kg of eight materials per m² of floor area by region, function and structure
provider: Fishman, T. et al., Zenodo record 10782341 (version 20230905, first public release B, data only)
credit: RASMI (Fishman et al. 2024, Scientific Data 11: 418), CC BY 4.0
licence: CC BY 4.0 (the Zenodo record's licence field, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode; checked 2026-11-13)
citation: Fishman, T., Mastrucci, A., Peled, Y., Saxe, S. and van Ruijven, B. (2024), RASMI: Global ranges of building material intensities differentiated by region, structure, and function, Scientific Data 11, 418, https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-024-03190-7 ; data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.10782341
format: An Excel workbook, one sheet per material (concrete, brick, wood, steel, glass, plastics, aluminum, copper), 384 rows each: function (RS residential single-family, RM residential multi-family, NR non-residential), structure (C concrete, M masonry, S steel, T timber), R5_32 (one of 32 regions, e.g. OECD_AUNZ for Australia and New Zealand), R5, the counts behind each range, and the percentiles p_0, p_5, p_25, p_50, p_75, p_95, p_100 of the material intensity in kg per m² of gross floor area. MD5 7545b40c91df28ba2f4125d2e44e2864. Region codes are RASMI's identifiers; places are named, wherever they are shown, by the data library's policy (data/products/naming.json).
coverage: The world, in 32 regions; no period of construction (an intensity holds for every year).

all.description: The ranges of every region, function and structure (198 kB)
